findings_not_failures.lane: SMB-BUSINESS-EVENTS-1 (lead note d: event ids document@revision#sequence)
findings_not_failures.finding: The event id is collision-free only while every event has its own revision. Entry-only events make no revision: set_document_entry does not advance the document revision (session.rs:2318-2335), and the run emits RAW_DEVELOPED / TEXT_EDITED / VECTOR_PATH_EDITED (entry tokens) and the HISTORY_UNDONE / REDONE of entry-only steps at self.revision(), i.e. the revision of the previous commit. Within one Run the per-revision counter (event_sequence) keeps ids apart, but it lives in the Run: a second Run (another CLI invocation, a reopened package, a viewer after close) on the same document at the same revision starts again at #0 and mints the id of an earlier, different event (e.g. the previous run's LAYER_MUTATED at R#0), which the immutable-envelope collision refusal (TransientBusinessEvents: Rejected, counted collisions; a host sink the same) turns into a lost event. The lane note ('revisions are unique per document ..., so the id is deterministic and collision-free while histories do not diverge') does not hold for entry-only events, which need no divergence.
findings_not_failures.repair_direction: give entry-only events an identity that survives runs (entry writes advance a revision, or the id carries the committing command's id/correlation from a host source, or the per-revision sequence is persisted with the document); add a test with two runs on one saved package
findings_not_failures.file_line: accord src/business_event.rs business_event_id; harness-core src/harness.rs business_event_entry (event_sequence), emit_entry_business_event (revision = self.revision()), history_step entry swap branch
findings_not_failures.evidence: static reading at 4f69b03b (export); lane notes event_identity and run_mapping ('an entry write itself makes no chronicle revision')

findings_not_failures.finding: TEXT_EDITED (entry token text) and the vector entry mapping are claimed produced (NOT_PRODUCED_ASSET_LOCALLY's complement, run_mapping) but no test exercises them: actions_and_entry_steps_emit_per_commit_with_their_causation covers develop -> RAW_DEVELOPED and the unmapped selection token only. Entry events also carry no change check: emit_entry_business_event fires after any successful set_document_entry, so rewriting identical entry bytes emits RAW_DEVELOPED / TEXT_EDITED although nothing changed, unlike the chronicle path (changed && !replayed) and the lane's own rule 'no-change edits emit nothing'.
